rules.name: Mass File Encryption Pattern
rules.description: Detection rules for ransomware indicators: encryption patterns, C2 behavior, lateral movement preceding ransomware deployment
rules.query: SELECT "siem_ransomware_ransomware_077", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mass%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%file%') AND "value" > 0
